_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: A patch tool card's header button opens the patched file in the editor without a watcher error. The conversation /c/{{SLUG}} patched the file {{FILE}}, which now contains "updated example". Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. 2. The first completed patch card ('.patch-tool[data-testid="tool-call-completed"]') should be visible (wait up to 15s). 3. Click the button named "Open in editor" in that card. 4. A dialog (role "dialog") whose accessible name contains "Edit {{FILE}}" should become visible (up to 15s). 5. In that dialog, a ".view-line" containing "updated example" should be visible (up to 15s). 6. Eval window.__pageErrors.filter(m => /before initialization|watcher callback/.test(m)).length and expect 0. 7. Press Escape. 8. The dialog should no longer be visible. 9. The patch card should still be visible (the editor is not nested in it).
